name: nexus
description: Agent bridge - WebSocket server for the Nexus app

scripts.build: cd server && tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/registry/agents.json','dist/registry/agents.json',{dereference:true});console.log('[build] copied agents.json')" && node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=f.readFileSync('dist/cli.mjs','utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!')){f.writeFileSync('dist/cli.mjs','#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);console.log('[build] added shebang to cli.mjs')}"
scripts.demo: node -e "console.log('1. Run: npm run build && npm run start'); console.log('2. Connect the Nexus app to the authenticated bridge'); console.log('3. Use npm run status / npm run stop to manage the daemon')"
scripts.test: npm run build && node server/test-auth.mjs && node server/test-session-ownership.mjs && node server/test-permission-delegation.mjs && node server/test-cancel-lifecycle.mjs && node server/test-session-callbacks.mjs && node server/test-terminal-delta.mjs && node server/test-session-titles.mjs && node server/test-session-watcher.mjs && node server/test-workspace-files.mjs && node server/test-start-gate.mjs && node server/test-context-replaced.mjs && node server/test-agents-store.mjs
